# HarvestFlow

> Fresh from the Helderberg's farms, straight to your door. Buy direct from local growers — always traceable, always in season.

HarvestFlow is a local produce marketplace connecting Helderberg-region farmers (Somerset West, Strand, Gordon's Bay, Stellenbosch, Paarl) directly with nearby customers. Farmers list seasonal harvests; customers order with delivery or pickup.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse fresh produce from local farms.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription plans for farmers and customers.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or log in.

## Optional

- [Cart](/cart): Review items before checkout.
- [Orders](/orders): Track your past and current orders.
